name: octopage
description: A static personal site whose content and comments both live in a GitHub repository.

scripts.preview:pages: pnpm build && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile pages up
scripts.preview:vercel: pnpm build && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile vercel up
scripts.preview:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile pages --profile pages-jekyll --profile vercel down
scripts.preview:jekyll: pnpm build && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile pages-jekyll up
